properties.name: accepts-transfers
properties.library_mapping: MinecraftServerConfiguration.acceptsTransfers gates HandshakeNextState.TRANSFER, sends the vanilla transfer-disabled Login disconnect, and exposes the transfer flag to admission, Configuration, Play Login, and the negotiation result.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Parse the property, opt in explicitly, and restore or validate any application state carried from the transferring server.

properties.name: allow-flight
properties.library_mapping: MinecraftInitialWorld.playerAbilities is configurable and serverbound movement packets remain available after negotiation; this property does not itself grant the client flight.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Track legitimate abilities and implement the vanilla-style illegal-flight detection and disconnect policy in the gameplay loop.

properties.name: broadcast-console-to-ops
properties.library_mapping: The library has no command console or operator broadcast subsystem and imposes no fixed behavior.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Implement console command output routing and operator audiences in the complete server.

properties.name: broadcast-rcon-to-ops
properties.library_mapping: The library has no RCON or operator broadcast subsystem and imposes no fixed behavior.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Implement RCON command output routing and operator audiences in the complete server.

properties.name: bug-report-link
properties.library_mapping: ConfigurationServerLinksPacket and PlayServerLinksPacket model custom or built-in bug-report links, and MinecraftServerHandler.configurationPackets can send the Configuration form.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Validate the configured URI and construct the desired server-link packet.

properties.name: chat-spam-threshold-seconds
properties.library_mapping: Typed chat packets are exposed to the application after Play; the library does not install a fixed spam window.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Measure chat activity, choose exemptions, and warn or disconnect according to the configured threshold.

properties.name: command-spam-threshold-seconds
properties.library_mapping: Typed command packets are exposed to the application after Play; the library does not install a fixed spam window.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Measure command activity, choose exemptions, and warn or disconnect according to the configured threshold.

properties.name: difficulty
properties.library_mapping: MinecraftServerConfiguration.difficulty flows through MinecraftInitialWorld.flatVanilla to ClientboundChangeDifficultyPacket, while custom worlds may select their own Difficulty.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Parse the property and apply its gameplay effects in addition to sending the protocol-visible value.

properties.name: enable-code-of-conduct
properties.library_mapping: CodeOfConductPacket and AcceptCodeOfConductPacket are modeled, and an ordered MinecraftServerHandler.configurationTasks exchange can wait for acceptance before Finish Configuration.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Load the code-of-conduct text, decide whether acceptance is mandatory, and reject clients that do not accept it.

properties.name: enable-jmx-monitoring
properties.library_mapping: The multiplatform library has no JVM-only JMX management server and does not reserve or hardcode one.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Expose JMX metrics in the JVM server application when requested.

properties.name: enable-query
properties.library_mapping: The Minecraft Query UDP service is separate from the Java Edition TCP protocol implemented here.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Create, secure, and stop a Query listener in the complete server.

properties.name: enable-rcon
properties.library_mapping: RCON is a separate administrative protocol and is not started or constrained by this library.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Create, authenticate, and stop an RCON service in the complete server.

properties.name: enable-status
properties.library_mapping: MinecraftServerConfiguration.statusEnabled gates Status handshakes before a request is read, matching the official server's no-status-response behavior.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Map the property to the configuration and close failed negotiations through the normal connection lifecycle.

properties.name: enforce-secure-profile
properties.library_mapping: Online authentication primitives, signed-chat packet models, and MinecraftServerConfiguration.enforcesSecureChat provide the authentication and wire-facing pieces without falsely forcing a policy.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Validate profile keys and signed chat or commands throughout Play, and set enforcesSecureChat only when that enforcement is genuinely active.

properties.name: enforce-whitelist
properties.library_mapping: MinecraftServerHandler.profileRejection is invoked before Login succeeds, can return a custom Login disconnect component, and delegates to acceptProfile for existing handlers; no whitelist source is hardcoded.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Own the whitelist, operator bypass rules, reload semantics, and online-player eviction policy.

properties.name: entity-broadcast-range-percentage
properties.library_mapping: Finite initial projection accepts an explicit entity list and Play exposes all entity spawn, move, update, and removal packet models; no tracking radius is fixed.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Calculate per-entity tracking ranges and choose each recipient in the authoritative entity tracker.

properties.name: force-gamemode
properties.library_mapping: MinecraftServerConfiguration.gameMode supplies the default, while MinecraftServerHandler.playLogin can choose a persisted or forced mode per profile.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Decide whether saved player modes are retained and issue later game-mode updates when policy changes.

properties.name: function-permission-level
properties.library_mapping: The library does not execute command functions or impose a permission model.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Implement function execution and permission checks in the command subsystem.

properties.name: gamemode
properties.library_mapping: MinecraftServerConfiguration.gameMode configures CommonPlayerSpawnInfo and vanilla initial PlayerAbilities; MinecraftServerHandler.playLogin can override it per player.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Parse the property and implement the corresponding gameplay rules and persisted-player selection.

properties.name: generate-structures
properties.library_mapping: World modules encode supplied NBT and region data but contain no fixed terrain or structure generator.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Configure structure generation in the consuming server's world generator.

properties.name: generator-settings
properties.library_mapping: World-format accepts already composed chunk NBT and does not interpret or restrict a generator-settings schema.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Parse the selected generator's settings and produce matching chunks and level metadata.

properties.name: hardcore
properties.library_mapping: MinecraftServerConfiguration.hardcore is written to PlayLoginPacket instead of being hardcoded.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Implement hardcore difficulty, death, ban, and world rules in the complete server.

properties.name: hide-online-players
properties.library_mapping: MinecraftServerHandler.statusJson controls the complete Status JSON document, so player samples and counts can be included, hidden, or transformed.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Build the player sample and privacy behavior from current server state.

properties.name: initial-disabled-packs
properties.library_mapping: MinecraftServerConfiguration.protocolData is injectable and supplies the Known Packs, registries, tags, and feature flags negotiated with clients.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Resolve enabled data packs, generate a coherent ProtocolDataSet, and keep its registries consistent with generated worlds.

properties.name: initial-enabled-packs
properties.library_mapping: MinecraftServerConfiguration.protocolData is injectable and supplies the Known Packs, registries, tags, and feature flags negotiated with clients.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Resolve enabled data packs, generate a coherent ProtocolDataSet, and keep its registries consistent with generated worlds.

properties.name: level-name
properties.library_mapping: MinecraftWorldPaths takes an arbitrary root Path; no world directory name is embedded in world-io.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Resolve the configured level directory safely and pass that path to MinecraftWorldPaths.

properties.name: level-seed
properties.library_mapping: Chunk NBT and initial-world snapshots are caller supplied, and MinecraftServerHandler.playLogin can set the spawn-info seed; the library does not substitute a constant authoritative seed.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Parse or generate the seed, use it in world generation, persist it, and expose the protocol's hashed seed where appropriate.

properties.name: level-type
properties.library_mapping: World chunks and dimension data are injectable and MinecraftServerHandler.playLogin controls isFlat and isDebug; the flat helper is optional.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Select and run the requested generator, then construct consistent dimension registry and Play data.

properties.name: log-ips
properties.library_mapping: The library does not install an access logger or force remote addresses into log messages.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Apply address redaction consistently in application logs, audit trails, and administrative services.

properties.name: management-server-allowed-origins
properties.library_mapping: The official JSON-RPC management service is outside the Minecraft wire and storage library.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Validate and enforce WebSocket or HTTP origins in any management server implementation.

properties.name: management-server-enabled
properties.library_mapping: The library starts no JSON-RPC management endpoint and therefore does not fix its lifecycle.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Implement and explicitly start or stop the management service.

properties.name: management-server-host
properties.library_mapping: No management listener address is owned or hardcoded by the library.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Bind the management service to the configured interface with an appropriate security policy.

properties.name: management-server-port
properties.library_mapping: No management listener port is owned or hardcoded by the library.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Validate and bind the configured management-service port.

properties.name: management-server-secret
properties.library_mapping: The library has no management authentication secret and never generates or logs one.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Generate, store, compare, rotate, and redact the management credential securely.

properties.name: management-server-tls-enabled
properties.library_mapping: Management-server TLS is separate from Minecraft transport encryption and is not configured by protocol-transport.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Configure TLS for the management endpoint and reject unsafe combinations.

properties.name: management-server-tls-keystore
properties.library_mapping: The library does not load a management TLS keystore.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Resolve and load the configured keystore without exposing its contents.

properties.name: management-server-tls-keystore-password
properties.library_mapping: The library does not request, retain, or log a management keystore password.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Supply and protect the keystore password in the management service.

properties.name: max-chained-neighbor-updates
properties.library_mapping: There is no block-tick or neighbor-update engine in the finite protocol/world projection library.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Count and limit chained block updates in the authoritative world simulation.

properties.name: max-players
properties.library_mapping: MinecraftServerConfiguration.maximumPlayers drives Status and Play Login metadata, while MinecraftServerHandler.profileRejection supplies the admission decision and wire-visible reason.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Track concurrent players, apply operator or reserved-slot policy, and reject excess admissions.

properties.name: max-tick-time
properties.library_mapping: The library has no authoritative server tick loop or watchdog and therefore fixes no timeout.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Measure ticks and implement watchdog shutdown or recovery in the full server runtime.

properties.name: max-world-size
properties.library_mapping: Coordinate models enforce only physical protocol bounds; callers choose which chunks, teleports, and movements are accepted.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Clamp the configured border and enforce it in generation, movement, teleportation, and chunk loading.

properties.name: motd
properties.library_mapping: MinecraftServerConfiguration.statusDescription configures the default Status response, and MinecraftServerHandler.statusJson can supply a richer component.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Parse formatting or component syntax as desired and expose current status state.

properties.name: network-compression-threshold
properties.library_mapping: MinecraftServerConfiguration.compressionThreshold selects the Login compression packet and transport threshold; null disables compression.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Map a negative server.properties value to null and a non-negative value directly.

properties.name: online-mode
properties.library_mapping: MinecraftServerAuthentication.Offline or Online selects offline UUIDs versus injected cryptography and session-service verification, and Play Login reports the resulting mode.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Construct Online authentication with production cryptography/session services or explicitly choose Offline and handle its identity risks.

properties.name: op-permission-level
properties.library_mapping: The library does not define operators, commands, or permission levels.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Own operator data and enforce the configured command permission level.

properties.name: pause-when-empty-seconds
properties.library_mapping: The library has no global tick scheduler to pause and does not assume one.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Observe player occupancy and pause or resume the full server simulation.

properties.name: player-idle-timeout
properties.library_mapping: After Play entry, the application owns packet dispatch and can observe activity without a library-fixed idle timer.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Define activity, exemptions, warning behavior, and disconnect timing.

properties.name: prevent-proxy-connections
properties.library_mapping: MinecraftServerConfiguration.preventProxyConnections passes the accepted socket's numeric peer address to MinecraftSessionService.hasJoined and fails closed when the address is unavailable.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Map the property and ensure any trusted proxy architecture preserves the intended authentication semantics.

properties.name: query.port
properties.library_mapping: The separate UDP Query protocol is not bound by MinecraftServer.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Validate and bind this port when implementing Query.

properties.name: rate-limit
properties.library_mapping: MinecraftServer exposes accepted Ktor sockets but does not impose a global per-address connection limiter.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Track connection attempts, choose proxy-aware address keys, and reject excess connections before expensive negotiation.

properties.name: rcon.password
properties.library_mapping: The library does not retain or compare RCON credentials.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Require, protect, and authenticate the configured RCON password.

properties.name: rcon.port
properties.library_mapping: MinecraftServer binds only the Minecraft TCP socket requested by its caller.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Validate and bind the separate RCON port.

properties.name: region-file-compression
properties.library_mapping: WorldRegionStore.writeChunkNbt accepts RegionCompression, and the built-in codecs cover vanilla GZIP, ZLIB/deflate, uncompressed, and LZ4 region payloads.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Map the textual setting to RegionCompression and decide migration behavior for existing chunks.

properties.name: require-resource-pack
properties.library_mapping: ConfigurationAddResourcePackPacket exposes its forced flag, and an ordered MinecraftServerHandler.configurationTasks exchange can wait for a chosen terminal resource-pack response before Play.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Set forced, evaluate every response state, and disconnect clients when the configured requirement is not met.

properties.name: resource-pack
properties.library_mapping: ConfigurationAddResourcePackPacket and PlayAddResourcePackPacket accept a caller-supplied URL; no URL is embedded by the library.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Validate and serve the configured resource-pack URL and choose when to push it.

properties.name: resource-pack-id
properties.library_mapping: Resource-pack push and response packets carry an arbitrary Uuid selected by the application.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Parse or derive a stable UUID and correlate responses to the active pack.

properties.name: resource-pack-prompt
properties.library_mapping: ConfigurationAddResourcePackPacket.promptMessage accepts an optional TextComponent.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Parse the configured component and supply null when no prompt is configured.

properties.name: resource-pack-sha1
properties.library_mapping: Resource-pack push packets expose the complete hash string and apply its wire length bound without replacing it.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Validate or calculate the pack SHA-1 and keep it synchronized with the served bytes.

properties.name: server-ip
properties.library_mapping: MinecraftServer.bind accepts an arbitrary host and defaults to the wildcard address rather than reading a file.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Map an empty value to the desired wildcard interface or pass the configured address.

properties.name: server-port
properties.library_mapping: MinecraftServer.bind accepts an arbitrary port and exposes the bound port.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Validate and pass the configured TCP port.

properties.name: simulation-distance
properties.library_mapping: MinecraftServerConfiguration.simulationDistance flows to Play Login and initial SetSimulationDistancePacket without an embedded value.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Apply official range normalization and use the value to control the authoritative simulation.

properties.name: spawn-protection
properties.library_mapping: Spawn position and all block interaction packets are typed, while the library installs no fixed protected radius.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Determine spawn, operator exemptions, dimensions, and deny protected interactions.

properties.name: status-heartbeat-interval
properties.library_mapping: This setting controls official JSON-RPC management notifications, not the Minecraft Status handshake.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Schedule management-server heartbeat notifications when that optional service exists.

properties.name: sync-chunk-writes
properties.library_mapping: WorldRegionStore exposes explicit completing write operations and contains no hidden global write queue.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Await writes for synchronous semantics or schedule and safely drain a serialized background writer for asynchronous semantics.

properties.name: text-filtering-config
properties.library_mapping: Chat, command, book, and sign packet contents remain typed and available to the application; no filtering endpoint is hardcoded.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Configure the external filtering service and apply results consistently to every relevant content path.

properties.name: text-filtering-version
properties.library_mapping: The protocol library does not assume a filtering service version and leaves content policy above packet transport.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Select the external filtering API behavior corresponding to the configured version.

properties.name: use-native-transport
properties.library_mapping: Ktor SelectorManager and socket construction are supplied by the caller; the library does not select a JVM native event-loop implementation.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Choose and configure the runtime's supported Ktor transport/event loop.

properties.name: view-distance
properties.library_mapping: MinecraftServerConfiguration.viewDistance is validated against the protocol's supported range and flows to Play Login, initial render distance, and the flat projection radius.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Normalize the property, stream and unload chunks as players move, and enforce resource limits.

properties.name: white-list
properties.library_mapping: MinecraftServerHandler.profileRejection is the pre-Login admission hook, supports a custom disconnect reason, and does not assume a whitelist implementation.
properties.consumer_responsibility: Load and mutate whitelist state and combine the enabled flag with enforce-whitelist semantics.
